sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Rahul Saxena
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of this bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No.
189 of 2022 at Police Station Bilsanda District Pilibhit under Section 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
The applicant is in jail since 21.04.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 24.09.2022.

The following arguments made by Shri Rahul Saxena, learned counsel assisted by Shri Rahul Kumar Pal, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Paritosh Kumar Malviya, learned AGA-I from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
1. The applicant is the husband of the deceased.
Raju vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116824258/
1
2. The applicant was married for eight years to the deceased.
Two children were born in wedlock.
One child is 7 years of age and the age of the second child is 4 years.
3. The applicant never tortured the deceased nor did he demand dowry.
The applicant is bereaved by the death of his wife.
4. The deceased was a sensitive person who was depressed on account of financial stringencies being faced by the family.
Though the applicant always tried to reassure her with the promise of good times are ahead.
4. On the fateful day, the deceased succumbed to depression and took the extreme step of ending her life.
Apparently she consumed some poisonous substance without knowledge of the applicant.
5. The applicant was away working in his agricultural field when the incident happened.
6. The postmortem report opines that the cause of death are uncertain.
7. The applicant has been falsely roped in only out of vindictiveness.
8. The applicant did not aid or abet the suicide.
9. Prosecution evidence does not connect the applicant with the offence.

10. The applicant and the deceased have two children who are bereft of their father's affection and guidance on account of the imprisonment of the applicant and have been denied the love and care of their mother after the death of the deceased.
11. The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from this case.
12. The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Raju be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
Raju vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116824258/
2
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 20.7.2023 Dhananjai  Raju vs State Of U.P. on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116824258/
